    ordinary=[c for c in x if not c.startswith(('proxy_','sequence_','interaction_'))]
    mode=spec['features']
    if mode=='price':return [c for c in x if c.startswith('price_')]
    if mode=='sector':return [c for c in x if c.startswith(('price_','sector_'))]
    if mode=='nofo':return [c for c in ordinary if not c.startswith(('fo_','institution_'))]
    if mode=='sequence':return [c for c in x if c.startswith(('price_','sequence_'))]
    if mode=='proxy':return ordinary+[c for c in x if c.startswith('proxy_')]
    if mode=='interaction':return ordinary+[c for c in x if c.startswith('interaction_')]
    return ordinary

class Preprocess:
    def fit(self,x,columns_,prune=False):
        self.columns=[c for c in columns_ if x[c].notna().sum()>=30]
        a=x[self.columns].to_numpy(float)
        self.median=np.array([np.median(c[np.isfinite(c)]) if np.isfinite(c).any() else 0 for c in a.T])
        filled=np.where(np.isfinite(a),a,self.median);self.mean=filled.mean(axis=0);self.std=filled.std(axis=0)
        self.std[self.std<1e-8]=1
        self.keep=np.arange(len(self.columns))
        if prune and len(self.keep):
            z=(filled-self.mean)/self.std
            with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):corr=np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(z,rowvar=False))
            selected=[]
            for j in range(len(self.columns)):
                if not selected or np.max(np.abs(corr[j,selected]))<.9:selected.append(j)
            self.keep=np.array(selected,dtype=int)
        return self
    def transform(self,x):
        a=x[self.columns].to_numpy(float);missing=~np.isfinite(a)
        z=np.clip((np.where(missing,self.median,a)-self.mean)/self.std,-5,5)
        # No missingness-date indicators: avoid learning provider launch dates.
        return z[:,self.keep]

def empirical_sample(values,weights=None):
    v=np.asarray(values,float);order=np.argsort(v);v=v[order]
    w=np.ones(len(v)) if weights is None else np.asarray(weights)[order]
    cum=np.cumsum(w)/np.sum(w)
    return v[np.minimum(np.searchsorted(cum,PROBS),len(v)-1)]

def fit_classifier(a,y,elastic=False):
    if len(np.unique(y))<2:return float((y.sum()+1)/(len(y)+2))
    model=LogisticRegression(C=.1,solver='saga' if elastic else 'lbfgs',l1_ratio=.5 if elastic else 0,
        max_iter=3000,random_state=SEED)
    model.fit(a,y.astype(int));return model

def classifier_predict(model,a):
    return np.full(len(a),model) if isinstance(model,float) else model.predict_proba(a)[:,1]

def tree(a,y,objective='regression',alpha=None):
    params={'objective':objective,'verbosity':-1,'num_leaves':4,'max_depth':2,'min_data_in_leaf':40,
        'learning_rate':.04,'lambda_l2':10.,'num_threads':1,'deterministic':True,'force_col_wise':True,'seed':SEED}
    if alpha is not None:params['alpha']=alpha
    return lgb.train(params,lgb.Dataset(a,label=y),num_boost_round=80)

def train(spec,x,labels):
    from .validation import validate_frame
    validate_frame(x)
    kind=spec['kind']
    if kind in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime']:
        x=x.tail(252);labels=labels.loc[x.index]
    y=labels['return'].to_numpy(float);rv=labels.volatility.to_numpy(float)
    model={'spec':spec,'y':y,'vol':rv,'tail02':labels.path_loss.lt(-.02).to_numpy(float),
        'tail05':labels.path_loss.lt(-.05).to_numpy(float),'x':x.copy(),
        'risk_median':float(x.price_rv21.median()),'rv_origin':x.price_rv21.to_numpy(float)}
    if kind in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime']:return model
    pre=Preprocess().fit(x,columns(x,spec),spec['features']=='pruned');a=pre.transform(x);model['pre']=pre
    if kind=='analogue':model['z']=a;return model
    if kind=='lgbm':
        model['mean_model']=tree(a,y);model['quantile_models']=[tree(a,y,'quantile',q) for q in QUANTILES]
        model['direction_model']=tree(a,(y>0).astype(float),'binary') if len(np.unique(y>0))>1 else float(np.mean(y>0))
        model['vol_model']=tree(a,rv)
        for key in ['tail02','tail05']:
            target=model[key];model[key+'_model']=tree(a,target,'binary') if len(np.unique(target))>1 else float(np.mean(target))
    else:
        model['mean_model']=(ElasticNet(alpha=spec['parameters']['alpha'],l1_ratio=.5,max_iter=10000,random_state=SEED)
                             if kind=='elastic' else Ridge(alpha=spec['parameters']['alpha'])).fit(a,y)
        model['direction_model']=fit_classifier(a,(y>0).astype(float),kind=='elastic')
        model['vol_model']=Ridge(alpha=100).fit(a,rv)
        for key in ['tail02','tail05']:model[key+'_model']=fit_classifier(a,model[key])
    return model

def predict(model,x,residuals=None):
    spec=model['spec'];kind=spec['kind'];y=model['y'];n=len(y);output=[]
    a=model['pre'].transform(x) if 'pre' in model else None
    if kind not in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime','analogue']:
        means=model['mean_model'].predict(a)
        p=(model['direction_model'].predict(a) if kind=='lgbm' and not isinstance(model['direction_model'],float)
           else classifier_predict(model['direction_model'],a))
        volatility=np.maximum(.02,model['vol_model'].predict(a))
        tails={key:(model[key+'_model'].predict(a) if kind=='lgbm' and not isinstance(model[key+'_model'],float)
                     else classifier_predict(model[key+'_model'],a)) for key in ['tail02','tail05']}
        if kind=='lgbm':qraw=np.column_stack([m.predict(a) for m in model['quantile_models']])
    for j,(_,row) in enumerate(x.iterrows()):
        weights=np.ones(n)
        if kind=='ewma':weights=np.exp2((np.arange(n)-(n-1))/63)
        if kind in ['momentum','reversion','regime']:
            trainx=model['x']
            if kind=='momentum':mask=(trainx.price_ret21>0).to_numpy()==(row.price_ret21>0)
            elif kind=='reversion':mask=(trainx.price_ret5>0).to_numpy()!=(row.price_ret5>0)
            else:mask=((trainx.price_ret21>0).to_numpy()==(row.price_ret21>0))&((trainx.price_rv21>model['risk_median']).to_numpy()==(row.price_rv21>model['risk_median']))
            weights=np.ones(n)*30/n
            if mask.any():weights+=mask.astype(float)
        if kind=='analogue':
            distance=np.mean((model['z']-a[j])**2,axis=1);nearest=np.argsort(distance)[:30]
            weights=np.ones(n)*30/n;extra=1/(np.sqrt(distance[nearest])+.25);extra*=30/extra.sum();weights[nearest]+=extra
        weights/=weights.sum()
        if kind in ['empirical','ewma','momentum','reversion','regime','analogue']:
            sample=empirical_sample(y,weights);mean=float(np.dot(weights,y));prob=float(np.dot(weights,y>0))
            vol=float(np.dot(weights,model['vol']));tail02=float(np.dot(weights,model['tail02']));tail05=float(np.dot(weights,model['tail05']));crossings=0
        elif kind in ['rv_scaled','vix_scaled']:
            scale=(row.price_rv21 if kind=='rv_scaled' else row.risk_vix/100/np.sqrt(252))/np.maximum(.001,model['rv_origin'])
            scaled=y*np.clip(scale,.5,2);sample=empirical_sample(scaled)
            mean=float(scaled.mean());prob=float(np.mean(scaled>0));vol=float(row.price_rv21*np.sqrt(252) if kind=='rv_scaled' else row.risk_vix/100)
            tail02=float(np.mean(model['tail02']));tail05=float(np.mean(model['tail05']));crossings=0
        else:
            mean=float(means[j]);prob=float(p[j]);vol=float(volatility[j]);tail02=float(tails['tail02'][j]);tail05=float(tails['tail05'][j])
            if kind=='lgbm':
                quant=qraw[j];crossings=int(np.sum(np.diff(quant)<0));quant=np.sort(quant)
                sample=np.interp(PROBS,QUANTILES,quant)
                # Explicit extrapolation beyond directly fitted 5/95 percentiles.
                sample[PROBS<.05]=quant[0]+(PROBS[PROBS<.05]-.05)*(quant[1]-quant[0])/.05
                sample[PROBS>.95]=quant[-1]+(PROBS[PROBS>.95]-.95)*(quant[-1]-quant[-2])/.05
            else:
                # Residuals come from an earlier purged inner validation fit.
                pool=np.asarray(residuals) if residuals is not None and len(residuals)>=20 else y-y.mean()
                sample=mean+empirical_sample(pool);crossings=0
        output.append({'p':float(np.clip(prob,.02,.98)),'mean':mean,'vol':max(.001,vol),
            'tail02':float(np.clip(tail02,.001,.999)),'tail05':float(np.clip(tail05,.001,.999)),
            'samples':sample,'crossings':crossings})
    return output

"""Independent randomized-direction controls with full maturity/purging rules."""
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from .audit import OUT,save
from .models import SPECS,train,predict,SEED
from .experiment import available,score_prediction,summarize,paired_ci

def main():
    x=pd.read_csv(OUT/'features.csv',index_col=0);results=[];records=[]
    for h in [5,21]:
        original=pd.read_csv(OUT/f'labels-{h}.csv',index_col=0)
        for seed in [SEED,SEED+1,SEED+2]:
            labels=original.copy();rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
            signs=rng.choice([-1,1],len(labels))
            labels['return']=labels['return'].abs()*signs
            labels['direction']=(labels['return']>0).astype(float)
            months={}
            for day in x.index:
                if day>='2026-07-01' and len(available(labels,day))>=126:months.setdefault(day[:7],[]).append(day)
            for month,query in months.items():
                tr=available(labels,query[0]);model=train(SPECS['M01_ridge_full'],x.loc[tr],labels.loc[tr])
                predictions=predict(model,x.loc[query])
                for day,p in zip(query,predictions):
                    if not np.isfinite(labels.loc[day,'return']):continue
                    records.append({'horizon':h,'seed':seed,'origin':day,'endpoint':labels.loc[day,'endpoint'],
                        'target':'independent randomized direction; volatility targets intentionally not randomized',**score_prediction(p,labels.loc[day])})
    frame=pd.DataFrame(records);frame.to_csv(OUT/'randomized-control-predictions.csv',index=False)
    for (h,seed),g in frame.groupby(['horizon','seed']):
        results.append({'horizon':int(h),'seed':int(seed),'metrics':summarize(g),
            'direction_improvement_ci95':paired_ci(.25-g.brier.to_numpy(),int(h)),
            'interpretation':'Negative control for direction only; no model selection from these results'})
    save('negative-controls.json',results)
    print('Randomized-target controls complete',len(results),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# NIFTY V3 research

Executed 17 November 2026 using observations dated 1 January 2025 through
16 November 2026. Read [the research summary](../../NIFTY_V3_RESEARCH.md) and
[the frozen design](DESIGN.md) before interpreting results.

The result is **no independently established predictive edge**. All historical
evaluation dates were already exposed to research. The final numerical scenarios
were issued after the market opened and are explicitly late-issued as-of
reconstructions, not fresh premarket forecasts or calibrated trading signals.

## Reproduce the numerical experiment

Run from the repository root, using the existing application environment. The
research-specific numerical library versions are in `requirements.txt`; the
application's backend dependencies are also needed for settings/database imports.
The original execution used Python 3.15.0. This command does not download new
data, overwrite run-001, send orders or create an automation:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m research.nifty_forecast_v3.reproduce --out artifacts/nifty_forecast_v3/2026-11-17/reproduction-002
```

Choose a new destination for each repetition. It verifies frozen dataset hashes,
refits the registered configurations and compares the numerical predictions to
run-001. Reproduction is a repeatability check, not independent validation.

To inspect the existing run's verification suite:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m research.nifty_forecast_v3.verify
```

The suite writes `verification.json`; regenerating it changes its file hash, so
retain the original frozen record when checking forecast provenance. To run the
same assertions without rewriting that record:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest research.nifty_forecast_v3.verify
```

## Files and provenance

- `MISSION.md` preserves the user's complete research request.
- `DESIGN.md` and `registry-config.json` record the finite model budget and
  chronological design; the registry is inside the artifact run directory.
- `audit.py`, `data.py`, `audit_report.py` and `features.py` implement discovery,
  acquisition, source classification, features and matured labels.
- `models.py` and `experiment.py` implement model fitting, purged inner selection,
  refits, per-origin predictions and target-specific scoring.
- `discovery.py`, `analyze.py`, `negative_controls.py`, `legacy_diagnosis.py` and
  `verify.py` implement the information search, comparisons and failure audits.
- `freeze.py` refuses to overwrite an existing forecast. Its original output
  remains unchanged. `reports.py` generates the research reports from saved scores.

Artifact directory: `artifacts/nifty_forecast_v3/2026-11-17/run-001`.
It includes all ten required reports, source/dataset hashes, original-fit source,
532 configuration/fold records, model files, predictions, conditional diagnostics,
negative controls, frozen scenarios, verification and the delivery manifest.

Schema/availability guards and explicit contract-ID exclusion were added after the
first batch. `source-at-first-fit`, `fit-source-archive.json` and
`guard-amendment.json` distinguish the initial fitted code from that amendment.
Checks reproduced the exact feature matrix and representative linear/boosted
predictions. No model settings or outcome-driven selection changed.

Historical source delivery clocks and revision vintages are incompletely archived.
One additional domestic-session lag for derivatives/institutional reports and
conservative global joins reduce timing risk but do not establish vintage fidelity.
Current-member stock breadth is a research-only proxy excluded from selectors.
Do not rerun acquisition scripts into the frozen directory.

# 03 — Independently defined prediction targets

Weekly=5 and monthly=21 actual observed NSE sessions. Endpoint return is
C[t+h]/C[t]-1. Separate evaluated targets: direction, direct mean return, median,
absolute magnitude, full return distribution, annualized future RMS volatility,
and path breaches below -2% and -5%. Seven fixed endpoint-return buckets use
-5%, -2%, -.5%, +.5%, +2%, +5% boundaries. None was chosen using outer outcomes.

All labels carry endpoint dates. A row can train any layer only when its endpoint
is **strictly earlier** than the new decision's completed-session origin. The
extra-session embargo applies inside inner validation too. Actual session bars,
including valid special sessions, define horizon length; future dates use the
published NSE calendar. Known 2025/2026 historical index calendars were checked
in earlier audits; the fresh complete 465-session index agrees with official FO
underlying on all 465 dates, maximum difference 0 points.

Volatility is sqrt(252*mean(future daily log-return squared)). A path breach is
min(future daily closes)/origin close-1, not a reconstructed intraday drawdown.
The future trend/transition state is **NOT VALIDATED**: V3 tests causal origin-
regime-conditioned return forecasts, not a certified forecast of latent regimes.

Return models regress future returns directly. Linear residual distributions
use purged inner held-out residuals; boosted models directly fit seven quantiles.
Quantile crossings are sorted and counted. Beyond 5/95 percentiles, tail
extrapolation is explicitly NOT VALIDATED. This replaces the earlier sign-only
mixture, but it does not guarantee coverage. Independent target selectors can
disagree; no joint coherence or calibrated probability claim is made.

Direction: Brier/log loss/accuracy/balanced accuracy/calibration. Returns:
MAE/RMSE/median MAE. Distribution: empirical CRPS, pinball, seven-bucket Brier,
50/80% interval coverage and width. Risk: volatility MAE/QLIKE and path-tail Brier.
Origin regimes use only observed trend, training-median RV, participation, expiry,
global risk-off and preceding large moves. Conditional diagnostics are descriptive;
no favorable slice becomes an independently validated subgroup edge.

Novel insight: different targets prefer different methods, and selecting a model
for return MAE does not establish direction, volatility or interval skill. Current
cross-target inconsistencies are recorded in the final JSON rather than hidden.

# 05 — Validation, leakage and uncertainty audit

History strictly 2025-01-01 through 2026-11-16. First feature origin is
2025-04-02 after 63-session warmup inside the permitted period.
No pre-2025 trained state is imported. All dates were already research-exposed
by previous studies: **no historical split is called untouched confirmation**.

Monthly chronological refits use only matured endpoints plus one-session embargo.
The latest42 eligible origins form inner validation. Inner fitting purges any
label whose endpoint reaches that inner period. Inner training must have80 labels,
and outer fitting at least126 matured labels; this necessarily delays the first
monthly development forecast. Targets independently choose configurations using
inner Brier, MAE, CRPS, QLIKE or tail Brier. Outer stress origins begin2026-07-01.
Scaling, imputation, correlation pruning, risk thresholds and selective-forecast
thresholds are training-only. Provider-launch missingness indicators are not used.

Weekly outer evaluation has 92 overlapping origins, 19 non-overlapping windows
and outcome-autocorrelation ESS about23.45. Monthly has 76 origins, four disjoint
windows and ESS about5.96. Neither count guarantees independence. Monthly paired
intervals are withheld: 76<168 required origins for the prespecified 42-session
block. Weekly blocks have10 sessions and 2,000 resamples. Simultaneous intervals
span 170 model/policy-and-target contrasts; **none has a positive lower bound**.
The strongest fixed baseline is identified on outer data and marked postselected;
inner-only baseline selectors are also reported and can themselves overfit.

15 focused tests passed. They check source/data hashes,
unchanged old calls, exact fitted-source archive, rejection of pre-2025 values,
registered future-oracle availability and unregistered future columns, unfinished
labels, inner purging, future-source/target perturbation invariance, cached feature
reproduction, representative model reproduction, horizon labels, proxy exclusion,
non-overlap, official FO identity/date checks, zero index volume, partial intraday
rejection and withholding unsupported monthly confidence intervals.

Six independently randomized-direction controls show no positive direction skill:
weekly Brier approximately .3359/.2840/.3575 and monthly .3448/.2809/.3285,
all worse than neutral .25. One randomized weekly accuracy is 54.9%; that isolated
accuracy does not create proper-score skill. Temporal-shift nulls are additionally
used in development feature discovery. Volatility is deliberately not randomized
in the direction controls and no claim is made that they test every target.

Hardening amendment: schema/time checks, explicit exclusion of a parsed contract
ID from numerical features and invalid-intraday-day checks were added after the
first batch. This is disclosed, not hidden as original pre-registration. Exact
initial fit code is archived in source-at-first-fit; tests confirm exact cached
features and representative ridge/LightGBM predictions are numerically unchanged.
No parameter/model selection changed. guard-amendment.json and verification.json
record this. Current source and exact fitted source are separately traceable.

Historical publication clocks and vendor revision vintages remain assumptions.
One extra session lag for FO/FII and conservative global joins reduce timing risk
but cannot manufacture an as-delivered archive. Current-basket proxy results are
ineligible for primary claims. Any apparent improvement remains conditional on
those source limitations.

## The earlier failures were reproduced, not discarded

Original monthly calibrated accuracy was 16.67% versus 52.78% raw; Brier .307490
versus .268606. Calibration flipped 17 predictions:15 correct-to-wrong and only 2
wrong-to-correct. Mean probability shifted from 52.29% to 52.96% while actual up
frequency was 36.11%; small average shifts hide damaging threshold crossings.
Weekly calibration flipped 26 calls with 13 improvements and 13 deteriorations,
but worsened Brier from .247161 to .249527. Overlapping-label prevalence shifts,
limited calibration diversity and nonstationarity explain plausible failure
mechanisms; this is not proof of a single causal explanation.

The exact old architecture was also refit using only 2025 onward, no old fitted
state. Its stringent252-training+126-OOS gates leave just 54 fully learned weekly
origins (11 disjoint) and 6 monthly origins (one disjoint). This demonstrates why
the old monthly model could not be reliably validated under this constraint.

Learned allocations can lose to equal groups because correlated errors plus
small effective meta samples produce unstable trust estimates. V3 tests raw
joint models and interactions without forcing the old group architecture or
its posthoc calibration. Some point scores improve, but nonlinear mechanisms
do not survive the current qualification standard. The joint FO+FII ablation
often improves the full linear model when removed; obtaining more authentic
data did not itself prove incremental predictive value. This does not isolate
FO from sparse FII or prove derivatives are universally uninformative.

Weekly and monthly rankings differ. Volatility/returns/distributions have
different leaders and different selectors. An attractive postselected volatility
score does not validate direction, interval coverage or a risk strategy. Current
member-basket proxies cannot establish true historical breadth skill, even if a
proxy ablation improves one score. Training feature gain and importance are not
causal effects.

Model selection can also overfit a 42-origin inner set, particularly when monthly
outcomes overlap. The nested baseline selector itself performs poorly; it is not
used as the sole benchmark. Fixed neutral/momentum/reversion and the strongest
fixed baseline are disclosed alongside it. Selective forecasts report coverage,
matched baselines and small counts; no favorable subgroup is promoted after inspection.

# 10 — What is missing and what would change the conclusion

1. Freeze one small weekly hypothesis prospectively: shallow nonlinear interactions
   versus neutral/reversion and a price+sector control, with unchanged features,
   parameters, decision clock and stop rule. The 66.3% exposed weekly result is a
   lead to investigate, not independent validation. Do not retune it on this outer set.
2. Capture true source delivery times and revision identities for every daily,
   global, FO and institutional input; retain both event and received clocks.
   Extra-day lags are assumptions, not substitutes for a delivery archive.
3. Acquire genuinely dated NIFTY constituent membership and weights, including
   additions/removals and corporate-action identities. Until then, keep today's
   basket out of primary breadth claims. Do not import pre-2025 market warmup.
4. Independently validate volatility/tail forecasts before any exposure decision.
   Direct quantiles still under-cover. Study low-dimensional price/sector risk
   models with a fixed distribution calibration protocol on fresh evidence;
   overlapping 42-origin residual windows do not supply 42 independent months.
5. Separate FO from institutional ablations on **development or new** data.
   The tested no-FO configuration removes both blocks, so a harmful joint result
   cannot identify the causal source. No new postselected sweep is justified here.
6. Record calibration threshold flips and rolling prevalence drift. The old
   monthly mapping destroyed 15 correct calls while correcting 2. Do not enforce
   calibration merely because it sounds statistically sophisticated.
7. Model selection needs more than a short inner overlap-heavy window. A baseline
   selector can also overfit. Keep fixed neutral/momentum/reversion benchmarks
   alongside any adaptive selector; preregister primary metrics and family budgets.

No model passes the current simultaneous qualification threshold, no evaluation
is genuinely untouched, and monthly independent counts are inadequate. Therefore
practical trading/exposure/fee optimization is **NOT QUALIFIED** under Phase 10;
none was run or represented as profitable. This avoids reusing forecasting
discovery observations to manufacture a trading-strategy success.

new non-overlapping weekly and 12–24 monthly outcomes for a very small frozen
comparison, with a dependence-aware power calculation using the realized paired
loss variance and declared model budget. The correct required N cannot be promised

settle the current monthly question. Extending collection/evaluation into 2027
would require an explicit change to the user's 2025–2026 constraint; no such
extension or automation is silently created.

A valid research outcome here is the precise null/inconclusive finding, authentic
new derivatives coverage, reproducible comparisons, rejected hypotheses and a
prospective evidence plan. More columns, more trees or a larger displayed

        spot=float(next(r['UndrlygPric'] for r in source if float(r.get('UndrlygPric') or 0)>0))
        row={'day':day,'spot_official':spot}
        if futures:
            f=min((r for r in futures if (r['FininstrmActlXpryDt'] or r['XpryDt'])>day),key=lambda r:r['FininstrmActlXpryDt'] or r['XpryDt'])
            row.update(fut_basis=float(f['ClsPric'])/spot-1,fut_oi=float(f['OpnIntrst']),fut_oi_change=float(f['ChngInOpnIntrst'])/max(1,float(f['OpnIntrst'])),
                fut_dte=(pd.Timestamp(f['FininstrmActlXpryDt'] or f['XpryDt'])-pd.Timestamp(day)).days,
                fut_contract=f['FinInstrmId'],fut_lot=float(f['NewBrdLotQty']))
        if expiries:
            expiry=expiries[0];legs=[r for r in options if (r['FininstrmActlXpryDt'] or r['XpryDt'])==expiry]
            call=[r for r in legs if r['OptnTp']=='CE'];put=[r for r in legs if r['OptnTp']=='PE']
            co=sum(float(r['OpnIntrst']) for r in call);po=sum(float(r['OpnIntrst']) for r in put)
            cv=sum(float(r['TtlTradgVol']) for r in call);pv=sum(float(r['TtlTradgVol']) for r in put)
            if co>0 and po>0:
                row.update(oi_pcr=np.log(po/co),volume_pcr=np.log((pv+1)/(cv+1)),
                    call_concentration=max(float(r['OpnIntrst']) for r in call)/co,
                    put_concentration=max(float(r['OpnIntrst']) for r in put)/po,
                    call_wall=max(call,key=lambda r:float(r['OpnIntrst']))['StrkPric'],
                    put_wall=max(put,key=lambda r:float(r['OpnIntrst']))['StrkPric'],
                    option_dte=(pd.Timestamp(expiry)-pd.Timestamp(day)).days)
                row['call_wall']=float(row['call_wall'])/spot-1;row['put_wall']=float(row['put_wall'])/spot-1
                strikes=np.array(sorted({float(r['StrkPric']) for r in legs}));payout=np.zeros(len(strikes))
                for r in legs:
                    strike=float(r['StrkPric']);oi=float(r['OpnIntrst'])
                    payout+=oi*(np.maximum(strikes-strike,0) if r['OptnTp']=='CE' else np.maximum(strike-strikes,0))
                row['maxpain_distance']=strikes[np.argmin(payout)]/spot-1
                current={r['FinInstrmId']:r for r in legs};prior=previous.get(expiry,{})
                common=[key for key in current.keys()&prior.keys() if current[key]['NewBrdLotQty']==prior[key]['NewBrdLotQty']]
                a=[current[k] for k in common];b=[prior[k] for k in common]
                totals=lambda l,s:sum(float(r['OpnIntrst']) for r in l if r['OptnTp']==s)
                values=[totals(l,s) for l,s in [(a,'PE'),(a,'CE'),(b,'PE'),(b,'CE')]]
                row['matched_pcr_change']=float(np.log(values[0]/values[1])-np.log(values[2]/values[3])) if min(values,default=0)>0 else np.nan
                previous[expiry]=current
        rows.append(row)
    frame=pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index('day').sort_index()
    frame['fut_oi_log_change']=np.log(frame.fut_oi.replace(0,np.nan)).diff()
    same=frame.fut_contract.eq(frame.fut_contract.shift())&frame.fut_lot.eq(frame.fut_lot.shift())
    frame['fut_roll_flag']=(~same).astype(float)
    frame.loc[~same,'fut_oi_log_change']=np.nan
    frame.to_csv(OUT/'fo-eod-panel.csv')
    return frame

BUCKETS=np.array([-.05,-.02,-.005,.005,.02,.05])
TARGET_METRICS={'direction':'brier','return':'mae','distribution':'crps','volatility':'qlike','tail':'tail02_brier'}

def available(labels,day):
    return labels.index[(labels.endpoint.notna())&(labels.endpoint<day)&labels['return'].notna()]

def validate_availability(decision,availability):
    if any(pd.Timestamp(stamp)>pd.Timestamp(decision) for stamp in availability):
        raise ValueError('LOOKAHEAD_SENTINEL: feature not yet available at decision')

def inner_split(labels,train_idx):
    validation=train_idx[-42:];first=validation[0]
    fitting=train_idx[(train_idx<first)&(labels.loc[train_idx,'endpoint'].to_numpy()<first)]
    return fitting,validation

def score_prediction(pred,row):
    samples=np.sort(np.asarray(pred['samples']));n=len(samples);y=float(row['return']);up=int(y>0);p=pred['p']
    q=np.quantile(samples,[.1,.25,.5,.75,.9]);b=np.bincount(np.digitize(samples,BUCKETS),minlength=7)/n
    one=np.zeros(7);one[int(np.digitize(y,BUCKETS))]=1
    crps=float(np.mean(abs(samples-y))-np.dot(2*np.arange(1,n+1)-n-1,samples)/(n*n))
    ratio=max(float(row.volatility)**2,1e-10)/max(pred['vol']**2,1e-10)
    return {'p':p,'outcome':up,'realized_return':y,'predicted_mean':pred['mean'],'predicted_median':float(q[2]),
        'brier':float((p-up)**2),'log_loss':float(-up*np.log(p)-(1-up)*np.log(1-p)),
        'mae':abs(pred['mean']-y),'squared_error':(pred['mean']-y)**2,'median_mae':abs(q[2]-y),
        'magnitude_mae':abs(float(np.mean(abs(samples)))-abs(y)),
        'crps':crps,'bucket_brier':float(np.sum((b-one)**2)),
        'pinball':float(np.mean(np.maximum(np.array([.1,.25,.5,.75,.9])*(y-q),(np.array([.1,.25,.5,.75,.9])-1)*(y-q)))),
        'coverage50':int(q[1]<=y<=q[3]),'coverage80':int(q[0]<=y<=q[4]),
        'width50':float(q[3]-q[1]),'width80':float(q[4]-q[0]),
        'q10':float(q[0]),'q25':float(q[1]),'q50':float(q[2]),'q75':float(q[3]),'q90':float(q[4]),
        'predicted_vol':pred['vol'],'realized_vol':float(row.volatility),'vol_mae':abs(pred['vol']-row.volatility),
        'qlike':float(ratio-np.log(ratio)-1),
        'tail02_p':pred['tail02'],'tail02_y':int(row.path_loss<-.02),
        'tail02_brier':float((pred['tail02']-int(row.path_loss<-.02))**2),
        'tail05_p':pred['tail05'],'tail05_brier':float((pred['tail05']-int(row.path_loss<-.05))**2),
        'dist_up_probability':float(np.mean(samples>0)),'quantile_crossings':pred['crossings'],
        **{f'bucket{k}_p':float(v) for k,v in enumerate(b)}}

def fold_prediction(spec,x,labels,train_idx,query_idx,cache_dir):
    fit_idx,val_idx=inner_split(labels,train_idx)
    if len(fit_idx)<80:raise ValueError('Insufficient purged inner training')
    inner=train(spec,x.loc[fit_idx],labels.loc[fit_idx])
    validation=predict(inner,x.loc[val_idx])
    inner_scores=[score_prediction(p,labels.loc[i]) for p,i in zip(validation,val_idx)]
    residuals=np.array([labels.loc[i,'return']-p['mean'] for p,i in zip(validation,val_idx)])
    model=train(spec,x.loc[train_idx],labels.loc[train_idx])
    forecast=predict(model,x.loc[query_idx],residuals)
    cache_dir.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    joblib.dump({'model':model,'residuals':residuals,'train_idx':list(train_idx),'inner_train_idx':list(fit_idx),
        'inner_validation_idx':list(val_idx),'preprocess_available_at':query_idx[0]},cache_dir,compress=3)
    pinner=np.array([p['p'] for p in validation]);threshold=max(.05,float(np.quantile(abs(pinner-.5),.8)))
    return forecast,inner_scores,{'train_n':len(train_idx),'first_training_origin':train_idx[0],
        'last_training_endpoint':labels.loc[train_idx,'endpoint'].max(),
        'inner_train_n':len(fit_idx),'inner_validation_n':len(val_idx),
        'last_inner_train_endpoint':labels.loc[fit_idx,'endpoint'].max(),'first_inner_validation_origin':val_idx[0],
        'confidence_threshold':threshold,'model_path':str(cache_dir),'model_sha256':sha(cache_dir)}

def summarize(frame):
    if frame.empty:return {'n':0}
    y=frame.outcome.to_numpy();p=frame.p.to_numpy();pred=p>=.5
    recalls=[float(np.mean(pred[y==value]==value)) for value in [0,1] if (y==value).any()]
    result={'n':len(frame),'accuracy':float(np.mean(pred==y)),
        'balanced_accuracy':float(np.mean(recalls)) if len(recalls)==2 else None,
        'rmse':float(np.sqrt(frame.squared_error.mean()))}
    for c in ['brier','log_loss','mae','median_mae','magnitude_mae','crps','pinball','bucket_brier','coverage50','coverage80',
              'width50','width80','qlike','vol_mae','tail02_brier','tail05_brier']:
        result[c]=float(frame[c].mean())
    bins=[]
    for lo,hi in zip([0,.35,.45,.55,.65],[.35,.45,.55,.65,1.00001]):
        mask=(p>=lo)&(p<hi)
        if mask.any():bins.append({'lo':lo,'hi':min(hi,1),'n':int(mask.sum()),'predicted':float(p[mask].mean()),'observed':float(y[mask].mean())})
    result['calibration_bins']=bins
    result['ece']=float(sum(b['n']*abs(b['predicted']-b['observed']) for b in bins)/len(frame))
    result['always_up_accuracy']=float(y.mean());result['always_down_accuracy']=float(1-y.mean())
    return result

def nonoverlap(frame):
    keep=[];last=''
    for i,r in frame.sort_values('origin').iterrows():
        if r.origin>=last:keep.append(i);last=r.endpoint
    return frame.loc[keep]

def effective_n(values,h):
    a=np.asarray(values,float);n=len(a)
    if n<5 or np.std(a)<1e-10:return None
    total=0
    for lag in range(1,min(2*h,n//4)+1):
        corr=np.corrcoef(a[:-lag],a[lag:])[0,1]
        if not np.isfinite(corr) or corr<=0:break
        total+=corr
    return float(np.clip(n/(1+2*total),1,n))

def paired_ci(values,h):
    a=np.asarray(values,float);n=len(a)
    if n<8*h:return None
    rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);block=2*h
    starts=rng.integers(0,n-block+1,(2000,int(np.ceil(n/block))))
    ix=(starts[:,:,None]+np.arange(block)).reshape(2000,-1)[:,:n]
    return np.quantile(a[ix].mean(axis=1),[.025,.975]).tolist()

    x=pd.read_csv(OUT/'features.csv',index_col=0);x.index=x.index.astype(str)
    (OUT/'models').mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    records=[];ledger=[];live={};all_inner=[]
    for h in [5,21]:
        labels=pd.read_csv(OUT/f'labels-{h}.csv',index_col=0,dtype={'origin':str,'endpoint':str})
        next_days=list(x.index[1:])+['2026-11-17'];labels['forecast_day']=next_days

        bymonth['LIVE_ASOF']=[x.index[-1]]
        for month,query in bymonth.items():
            began=time.monotonic();first=query[0];train_idx=available(labels,first)
            fold_results={};inner_results={};metadata={}
            for name,spec in SPECS.items():
                try:
                    forecasts,inner_scores,meta=fold_prediction(spec,x,labels,train_idx,query,OUT/'models'/f'h{h}-{month}-{name}.joblib')
                    fold_results[name]=forecasts;inner_results[name]=inner_scores;metadata[name]=meta

                        'research_only':spec['research_only'],'configurations_total':len(SPECS),

                except Exception as exc:
                    ledger.append({'experiment_id':f'V3-H{h}-{month}-{name}','horizon':h,'fold':month,'model':name,'status':'failed','error':str(exc)[:400]})
            # Deterministic requested controls add no fitted configurations.
            if 'B00_empirical' not in fold_results:raise RuntimeError('Empirical control failed; inspect ledger before proceeding')
            val_idx=inner_split(labels,train_idx)[1]
            control_p={
                'Z_neutral':lambda frame:np.full(len(frame),.5),
                'Z_momentum':lambda frame:np.where(frame.price_ret21>0,.55,.45),
                'Z_reversion':lambda frame:np.where(frame.price_ret5>0,.45,.55),
                'Z_always_up':lambda frame:np.full(len(frame),.98),
                'Z_always_down':lambda frame:np.full(len(frame),.02)}
            for control,fn in control_p.items():
                fold_results[control]=[{**p,'p':float(v)} for p,v in zip(fold_results['B00_empirical'],fn(x.loc[query]))]
                controls=[]
                for r,p in zip(inner_results['B00_empirical'],fn(x.loc[val_idx])):
                    up=r['outcome'];controls.append({**r,'p':float(p),'brier':float((p-up)**2),
                        'log_loss':float(-up*np.log(p)-(1-up)*np.log(1-p))})
                inner_results[control]=controls;metadata[control]=metadata['B00_empirical']
            valid=[name for name in fold_results if name not in SPECS or not SPECS[name]['research_only']]
            choices={target:min(valid,key=lambda name:np.mean([r[metric] for r in inner_results[name]])) for target,metric in TARGET_METRICS.items()}
            baseline_choices={target:min([name for name in valid if name.startswith(('B','Z'))],key=lambda name:np.mean([r[metric] for r in inner_results[name]])) for target,metric in TARGET_METRICS.items()}
            for name,scores in inner_results.items():
                all_inner.append({'horizon':h,'fold':month,'model':name,'inner_metrics':{metric:float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in scores])) for metric in TARGET_METRICS.values()}})
            if month=='LIVE_ASOF':
                live[str(h)]={'origin':first,'forecast_day':labels.loc[first,'forecast_day'],'train_n':len(train_idx),
                    'selectors':choices,'baseline_selectors':baseline_choices,
                    'forecasts':{name:[{k:(v.tolist() if isinstance(v,np.ndarray) else v) for k,v in f.items()} for f in forecasts] for name,forecasts in fold_results.items()},
                    'metadata':metadata,'inner_scores':{name:{metric:float(np.mean([r[metric] for r in scores])) for metric in TARGET_METRICS.values()} for name,scores in inner_results.items()}}
            else:
                # Each target's selector uses only the purged inner history.
                expanded={**fold_results,**{'S_'+target:fold_results[name] for target,name in choices.items()},
                    **{'C_'+target:fold_results[name] for target,name in baseline_choices.items()}}
                for j,day in enumerate(query):
                    if not np.isfinite(labels.loc[day,'return']):continue
                    regime='high_vol' if x.loc[day,'price_rv21']>x.loc[train_idx,'price_rv21'].median() else 'low_vol'
                    trend='trend' if abs(x.loc[day,'price_ret21'])/max(.001,x.loc[day,'price_rv21'])/np.sqrt(21)>1 else 'sideways'
                    for name,forecasts in expanded.items():
                        source=choices[name[2:]] if name.startswith('S_') else baseline_choices[name[2:]] if name.startswith('C_') else name
                        p=forecasts[j];score=score_prediction(p,labels.loc[day])
                        records.append({'horizon':h,'fold':month,'model':name,'selected_model':source,
                            'origin':day,'forecast_day':labels.loc[day,'forecast_day'],'endpoint':labels.loc[day,'endpoint'],
                            'split':'outer_exposed' if labels.loc[day,'forecast_day']>='2026-07-01' else 'development_exposed',
                            'regime':regime,'trend_regime':trend,'breadth_regime':'broad' if x.loc[day,'sector_participation']>=.5 else 'narrow',
                            'expiry_regime':'near' if x.loc[day,'fo_option_dte']<=2 else 'far',
                            'global_riskoff':bool(x.loc[day,'global_sp500_ret1']<x.loc[train_idx,'global_sp500_ret1'].quantile(.1)),
                            'large_prior_move':bool(abs(x.loc[day,'price_ret1'])>x.loc[train_idx,'price_ret1'].abs().quantile(.9)),
                            'selected_confident':bool(abs(p['p']-.5)>=metadata[source]['confidence_threshold']),**score})
            pd.DataFrame(records).to_csv(OUT/'predictions.csv',index=False)
            save('experiment-ledger.json',ledger);save('inner-validation.json',all_inner);save('current-model-record.json',live)
            print(f'h={h} fold={month}: {len(query)} origins; {len(fold_results)}/{len(SPECS)} configurations; {time.monotonic()-began:.1f}s',flush=True)
    frame=pd.DataFrame(records);results=[]
    for (h,model,split),g in frame.groupby(['horizon','model','split']):
        summary=summarize(g);summary.update({'horizon':int(h),'model':model,'split':split,
            'nonoverlapping_n':len(nonoverlap(g)),'outcome_autocorrelation_ess':effective_n(g.outcome,int(h)),
            'origin_first':g.forecast_day.min(),'origin_last':g.forecast_day.max(),
            'research_only':bool(model in SPECS and SPECS[model]['research_only'])})
        results.append(summary)
    save('metrics.json',results)
    print('Finished controlled V3 batch',len(ledger),'fits; predictions',len(frame),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':run()

from __future__ import annotations
import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from .audit import OUT,OLD,save,sha
from .data import load_series,fo_features,START,END

def build(data,fo=None):
    d=data['nifty_spot'];c=d.close.astype(float);r=c.pct_change();x=pd.DataFrame(index=d.index)
    rv=r.rolling(21).std().clip(lower=.001)
    for n in [1,5,10,21,63]:x[f'price_ret{n}']=c.pct_change(n)
    for n in [5,21,63]:x[f'price_rv{n}']=r.rolling(n).std()
    x['price_downvol21']=r.clip(upper=0).pow(2).rolling(21).mean().pow(.5)
    for n in [10,21,63]:x[f'price_ema{n}']=(c/c.ewm(span=n,adjust=False).mean()-1)/rv
    delta=c.diff();u=delta.clip(lower=0).ewm(alpha=1/14,adjust=False).mean();v=(-delta.clip(upper=0)).ewm(alpha=1/14,adjust=False).mean()
    x['price_rsi']=u/(u+v);x['price_acceleration']=c.pct_change(5)-c.pct_change(21)/4
    x['price_persistence']=r.gt(0).rolling(21).mean();x['price_rv_ratio']=x.price_rv5/rv
    tr=pd.concat([d.high-d.low,(d.high-c.shift()).abs(),(d.low-c.shift()).abs()],axis=1).max(axis=1)
    x['price_atr']=tr.rolling(14).mean()/c;x['price_body']=(d.close-d.open)/c
    x['price_range']=(d.high-d.low)/c;x['price_close_location']=(c-d.low)/(d.high-d.low).replace(0,np.nan)
    x['price_gap']=d.open/c.shift()-1
    vi=data['india_vix'].close.reindex(d.index).astype(float)
    x['risk_vix']=vi;x['risk_vix_change5']=vi.pct_change(5,fill_method=None)
    x['risk_vix_acceleration']=vi.pct_change(fill_method=None)-vi.pct_change(5,fill_method=None)/5
    x['risk_implied_realized_spread']=vi/100-rv*np.sqrt(252)
    sectors=[k for k in data if k.startswith('nifty_') and k not in ['nifty_spot','nifty_500']]+['bank_nifty']
    sector_returns=[]
    for key in sectors:
        sc=data[key].close.reindex(d.index).astype(float);rr=sc.pct_change(5,fill_method=None);sector_returns.append(rr)
        for n in [5,21]:x['sector_'+key+f'_rel{n}']=sc.pct_change(n,fill_method=None)-c.pct_change(n)
    sr=pd.concat(sector_returns,axis=1)
    x['sector_participation']=sr.gt(0).sum(axis=1)/sr.notna().sum(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan)
    x['sector_dispersion']=sr.std(axis=1);x['sector_breadth_change5']=x.sector_participation.diff(5)
    x['sector_divergence']=sr.mean(axis=1)-c.pct_change(5)
    x['sector_concentration']=sr.abs().max(axis=1)/sr.abs().sum(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan)
    x['sector_nifty500_relative']=data['nifty_500'].close.reindex(d.index).pct_change(21,fill_method=None)-c.pct_change(21)
    # Conservative 00:30 clock: latest source date strictly before origin day.
    for name,g in data.items():
        if not name.startswith('global_'):continue
        vals=pd.DataFrame({'ret1':g.close.pct_change(),'ret5':g.close.pct_change(5),'rv21':g.close.pct_change().rolling(21).std()},index=g.index)
        source_days=np.array(vals.index)
        for i,day in enumerate(d.index):
            j=np.searchsorted(source_days,day,side='left')-1
            if j>=0 and (pd.Timestamp(day)-pd.Timestamp(source_days[j])).days<=7:
                for col in vals:x.loc[day,name+'_'+col]=vals.iloc[j][col]
    etf=data['niftybees'].reindex(d.index)
    x['etf_relative_volume']=etf.volume/etf.volume.shift().rolling(21).median()
    x['etf_relative_turnover']=(etf.close*etf.volume)/(etf.close*etf.volume).shift().rolling(21).median()
    x['etf_tracking5']=etf.close.pct_change(5,fill_method=None)-c.pct_change(5)
    if fo is not None:
        numeric=fo.select_dtypes('number').drop(columns=['spot_official','fut_oi','fut_lot'],errors='ignore')
        lag=numeric.reindex(d.index).shift(1) # explicit additional publication lag
        x=pd.concat([x,lag.add_prefix('fo_')],axis=1)
    # Genuine institutional history; all dates are 2026, no earlier warmup.
    from research.nifty_forecast.adaptive import institutional_features
    inst,_=institutional_features(OLD/'institutional-v1',OLD/'inputs-v2',list(d.index))
    inst.index=d.index;x=pd.concat([x,inst.shift(1).add_prefix('institution_')],axis=1)
    p=OUT/'sources/nifty-intraday.csv'
    if p.exists():
        bars=pd.read_csv(p);bars['clock']=pd.to_datetime(bars.ts,utc=True).dt.tz_convert('Asia/Kolkata')
        bars['day']=bars.clock.dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d');bars['minute']=bars.clock.dt.hour*60+bars.clock.dt.minute
        bars=bars[(bars.minute>=555)&(bars.minute<=925)].drop_duplicates('ts').sort_values('ts')
        summaries=[]
        for day,b in bars.groupby('day'):
            if len(b)<70 or b.minute.min()!=555 or b.minute.max()<920:continue
            cr=b.close.pct_change().dropna();first=float(b.open.iloc[0]);last=float(b.close.iloc[-1])
            summaries.append({'day':day,'intraday_first_hour':float(b.close.iloc[min(11,len(b)-1)])/first-1,
                'intraday_last_hour':last/float(b.open.iloc[-12])-1,'intraday_rv':float(np.sqrt(np.sum(cr**2))),
                'intraday_efficiency':abs(last-first)/max(1e-9,float(b.close.diff().abs().sum())),
                'intraday_range':float(b.high.max()/b.low.min()-1)})
        intraday=pd.DataFrame(summaries).set_index('day').reindex(d.index)
        x=pd.concat([x,intraday],axis=1)
    # Current-membership proxy is separately tagged and ineligible for selectors.
    stocks=pd.concat({k:data[k].close for k in data if k.startswith('stock_')},axis=1).reindex(d.index)
    stock_ret=stocks.pct_change(fill_method=None);stock_ret=stock_ret.where(stock_ret.abs()<=.35)
    for n in [5,21,63]:
        momentum=stocks.pct_change(n,fill_method=None)
        x[f'proxy_above_ema{n}']=stocks.gt(stocks.ewm(span=n,adjust=False).mean()).mean(axis=1)
        x[f'proxy_momentum_dispersion{n}']=momentum.std(axis=1)
    x['proxy_advance_fraction']=stock_ret.gt(0).sum(axis=1)/stock_ret.notna().sum(axis=1).replace(0,np.nan)
    x['proxy_dispersion']=stock_ret.std(axis=1)
    x['proxy_equalweight_relative']=stock_ret.mean(axis=1).rolling(21).sum()-c.pct_change(21)
    x['proxy_new_high_fraction']=stocks.ge(stocks.shift().rolling(63).max()).mean(axis=1)
    x['proxy_new_low_fraction']=stocks.le(stocks.shift().rolling(63).min()).mean(axis=1)
    x['proxy_correlation']=stock_ret.rolling(21).corr(stock_ret.mean(axis=1)).mean(axis=1)
    x=x.copy()
    x['interaction_mom_risk']=x.price_ret21*x.price_rv21
    x['interaction_breadth_return']=x.sector_participation*x.price_ret5
    x['interaction_dispersion_risk']=x.sector_dispersion*x.price_rv21
    x['interaction_fii_trend']=x.institution_fii_futures_position_imbalance*x.price_ret21
    for col in ['price_ret1','price_ret5','price_rv21','sector_participation']:
        for lag in [1,3,5]:x[f'sequence_{col}_lag{lag}']=x[col].shift(lag)
    x['calendar_weekday']=pd.to_datetime(x.index).day_of_week.astype(float)
    valid=x.price_ret63.notna()&x.price_rv63.notna()
    return x.loc[valid].replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan),d.loc[valid]

def labels_for(price,h):
    c=price.close.to_numpy(float);n=len(c);rows=[]
    for i,day in enumerate(price.index):
        if i+h<n:
            path=c[i:i+h+1];lr=np.diff(np.log(path));ret=path[-1]/path[0]-1
            rows.append({'origin':day,'endpoint':price.index[i+h],'return':ret,'direction':float(ret>0),
                'volatility':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(lr**2)*252)),
                'path_loss':float(path[1:].min()/path[0]-1),'absolute_return':abs(ret)})
        else:rows.append({'origin':day,'endpoint':None,'return':np.nan,'direction':np.nan,'volatility':np.nan,'path_loss':np.nan,'absolute_return':np.nan})
    return pd.DataFrame(rows,index=price.index)

from __future__ import annotations
import warnings
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge,ElasticNet,LogisticRegression

SEED=20261117
SPECS=[
 ('B00_empirical','empirical','price',{}),('B01_ewma','ewma','price',{}),
 ('B02_rv_scaled','rv_scaled','price',{}),('B03_vix_scaled','vix_scaled','price',{}),
 ('B04_momentum','momentum','price',{}),('B05_reversion','reversion','price',{}),('B06_regime','regime','price',{}),
 ('M00_ridge_price','ridge','price',{'alpha':100}),('M01_ridge_full','ridge','full',{'alpha':100}),
 ('M02_elastic001','elastic','full',{'alpha':.001}),('M03_elastic01','elastic','full',{'alpha':.01}),
 ('M04_corr_ridge','ridge','pruned',{'alpha':100}),('M05_lgbm','lgbm','full',{}),
 ('M06_analog30','analogue','full',{}),('M07_sequence','ridge','sequence',{'alpha':100}),
 ('A00_sector','ridge','sector',{'alpha':100}),('A01_nofo','ridge','nofo',{'alpha':100}),
 ('A02_proxy','ridge','proxy',{'alpha':100}),('A03_interact','ridge','interaction',{'alpha':100})]
SPECS={name:{'id':name,'kind':kind,'features':features,'parameters':p,'research_only':features=='proxy'} for name,kind,features,p in SPECS}
QUANTILES=np.array([.05,.1,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95])
PROBS=(np.arange(201)+.5)/201

def columns(x,spec):
    ordinary=[c for c in x if not c.startswith(('proxy_','sequence_','interaction_'))]
    mode=spec['features']
    if mode=='price':return [c for c in x if c.startswith('price_')]
    if mode=='sector':return [c for c in x if c.startswith(('price_','sector_'))]
    if mode=='nofo':return [c for c in ordinary if not c.startswith(('fo_','institution_'))]
    if mode=='sequence':return [c for c in x if c.startswith(('price_','sequence_'))]
    if mode=='proxy':return ordinary+[c for c in x if c.startswith('proxy_')]
    if mode=='interaction':return ordinary+[c for c in x if c.startswith('interaction_')]
    return ordinary

class Preprocess:
    def fit(self,x,columns_,prune=False):
        self.columns=[c for c in columns_ if x[c].notna().sum()>=30]
        a=x[self.columns].to_numpy(float)
        self.median=np.array([np.median(c[np.isfinite(c)]) if np.isfinite(c).any() else 0 for c in a.T])
        filled=np.where(np.isfinite(a),a,self.median);self.mean=filled.mean(axis=0);self.std=filled.std(axis=0)
        self.std[self.std<1e-8]=1
        self.keep=np.arange(len(self.columns))
        if prune and len(self.keep):
            z=(filled-self.mean)/self.std
            with np.errstate(divide='ignore',invalid='ignore'):corr=np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(z,rowvar=False))
            selected=[]
            for j in range(len(self.columns)):
                if not selected or np.max(np.abs(corr[j,selected]))<.9:selected.append(j)
            self.keep=np.array(selected,dtype=int)
        return self
    def transform(self,x):
        a=x[self.columns].to_numpy(float);missing=~np.isfinite(a)
        z=np.clip((np.where(missing,self.median,a)-self.mean)/self.std,-5,5)
        # No missingness-date indicators: avoid learning provider launch dates.
        return z[:,self.keep]

def empirical_sample(values,weights=None):
    v=np.asarray(values,float);order=np.argsort(v);v=v[order]
    w=np.ones(len(v)) if weights is None else np.asarray(weights)[order]
    cum=np.cumsum(w)/np.sum(w)
    return v[np.minimum(np.searchsorted(cum,PROBS),len(v)-1)]

def fit_classifier(a,y,elastic=False):
    if len(np.unique(y))<2:return float((y.sum()+1)/(len(y)+2))
    model=LogisticRegression(C=.1,solver='saga' if elastic else 'lbfgs',l1_ratio=.5 if elastic else 0,
        max_iter=3000,random_state=SEED)
    model.fit(a,y.astype(int));return model

def classifier_predict(model,a):
    return np.full(len(a),model) if isinstance(model,float) else model.predict_proba(a)[:,1]

def tree(a,y,objective='regression',alpha=None):
    params={'objective':objective,'verbosity':-1,'num_leaves':4,'max_depth':2,'min_data_in_leaf':40,
        'learning_rate':.04,'lambda_l2':10.,'num_threads':1,'deterministic':True,'force_col_wise':True,'seed':SEED}
    if alpha is not None:params['alpha']=alpha
    return lgb.train(params,lgb.Dataset(a,label=y),num_boost_round=80)

def train(spec,x,labels):
    kind=spec['kind']
    if kind in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime']:
        x=x.tail(252);labels=labels.loc[x.index]
    y=labels['return'].to_numpy(float);rv=labels.volatility.to_numpy(float)
    model={'spec':spec,'y':y,'vol':rv,'tail02':labels.path_loss.lt(-.02).to_numpy(float),
        'tail05':labels.path_loss.lt(-.05).to_numpy(float),'x':x.copy(),
        'risk_median':float(x.price_rv21.median()),'rv_origin':x.price_rv21.to_numpy(float)}
    if kind in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime']:return model
    pre=Preprocess().fit(x,columns(x,spec),spec['features']=='pruned');a=pre.transform(x);model['pre']=pre
    if kind=='analogue':model['z']=a;return model
    if kind=='lgbm':
        model['mean_model']=tree(a,y);model['quantile_models']=[tree(a,y,'quantile',q) for q in QUANTILES]
        model['direction_model']=tree(a,(y>0).astype(float),'binary') if len(np.unique(y>0))>1 else float(np.mean(y>0))
        model['vol_model']=tree(a,rv)
        for key in ['tail02','tail05']:
            target=model[key];model[key+'_model']=tree(a,target,'binary') if len(np.unique(target))>1 else float(np.mean(target))
    else:
        model['mean_model']=(ElasticNet(alpha=spec['parameters']['alpha'],l1_ratio=.5,max_iter=10000,random_state=SEED)
                             if kind=='elastic' else Ridge(alpha=spec['parameters']['alpha'])).fit(a,y)
        model['direction_model']=fit_classifier(a,(y>0).astype(float),kind=='elastic')
        model['vol_model']=Ridge(alpha=100).fit(a,rv)
        for key in ['tail02','tail05']:model[key+'_model']=fit_classifier(a,model[key])
    return model

def predict(model,x,residuals=None):
    spec=model['spec'];kind=spec['kind'];y=model['y'];n=len(y);output=[]
    a=model['pre'].transform(x) if 'pre' in model else None
    if kind not in ['empirical','ewma','rv_scaled','vix_scaled','momentum','reversion','regime','analogue']:
        means=model['mean_model'].predict(a)
        p=(model['direction_model'].predict(a) if kind=='lgbm' and not isinstance(model['direction_model'],float)
           else classifier_predict(model['direction_model'],a))
        volatility=np.maximum(.02,model['vol_model'].predict(a))
        tails={key:(model[key+'_model'].predict(a) if kind=='lgbm' and not isinstance(model[key+'_model'],float)
                     else classifier_predict(model[key+'_model'],a)) for key in ['tail02','tail05']}
        if kind=='lgbm':qraw=np.column_stack([m.predict(a) for m in model['quantile_models']])
    for j,(_,row) in enumerate(x.iterrows()):
        weights=np.ones(n)
        if kind=='ewma':weights=np.exp2((np.arange(n)-(n-1))/63)
        if kind in ['momentum','reversion','regime']:
            trainx=model['x']
            if kind=='momentum':mask=(trainx.price_ret21>0).to_numpy()==(row.price_ret21>0)
            elif kind=='reversion':mask=(trainx.price_ret5>0).to_numpy()!=(row.price_ret5>0)
            else:mask=((trainx.price_ret21>0).to_numpy()==(row.price_ret21>0))&((trainx.price_rv21>model['risk_median']).to_numpy()==(row.price_rv21>model['risk_median']))
            weights=np.ones(n)*30/n
            if mask.any():weights+=mask.astype(float)
        if kind=='analogue':
            distance=np.mean((model['z']-a[j])**2,axis=1);nearest=np.argsort(distance)[:30]
            weights=np.ones(n)*30/n;extra=1/(np.sqrt(distance[nearest])+.25);extra*=30/extra.sum();weights[nearest]+=extra
        weights/=weights.sum()
        if kind in ['empirical','ewma','momentum','reversion','regime','analogue']:
            sample=empirical_sample(y,weights);mean=float(np.dot(weights,y));prob=float(np.dot(weights,y>0))
            vol=float(np.dot(weights,model['vol']));tail02=float(np.dot(weights,model['tail02']));tail05=float(np.dot(weights,model['tail05']));crossings=0
        elif kind in ['rv_scaled','vix_scaled']:
            scale=(row.price_rv21 if kind=='rv_scaled' else row.risk_vix/100/np.sqrt(252))/np.maximum(.001,model['rv_origin'])
            scaled=y*np.clip(scale,.5,2);sample=empirical_sample(scaled)
            mean=float(scaled.mean());prob=float(np.mean(scaled>0));vol=float(row.price_rv21*np.sqrt(252) if kind=='rv_scaled' else row.risk_vix/100)
            tail02=float(np.mean(model['tail02']));tail05=float(np.mean(model['tail05']));crossings=0
        else:
            mean=float(means[j]);prob=float(p[j]);vol=float(volatility[j]);tail02=float(tails['tail02'][j]);tail05=float(tails['tail05'][j])
            if kind=='lgbm':
                quant=qraw[j];crossings=int(np.sum(np.diff(quant)<0));quant=np.sort(quant)
                sample=np.interp(PROBS,QUANTILES,quant)
                # Explicit extrapolation beyond directly fitted 5/95 percentiles.
                sample[PROBS<.05]=quant[0]+(PROBS[PROBS<.05]-.05)*(quant[1]-quant[0])/.05
                sample[PROBS>.95]=quant[-1]+(PROBS[PROBS>.95]-.95)*(quant[-1]-quant[-2])/.05
            else:
                # Residuals come from an earlier purged inner validation fit.
                pool=np.asarray(residuals) if residuals is not None and len(residuals)>=20 else y-y.mean()
                sample=mean+empirical_sample(pool);crossings=0
        output.append({'p':float(np.clip(prob,.02,.98)),'mean':mean,'vol':max(.001,vol),
            'tail02':float(np.clip(tail02,.001,.999)),'tail05':float(np.clip(tail05,.001,.999)),
            'samples':sample,'crossings':crossings})
    return output

# NIFTY FORECASTING RESEARCH — V4
## Mission: Convert promising experiments into trustworthy predictive evidence

You have completed V1, V2 and V3 research using Upstox market data, NSE historical derivatives archives, and our internal market-analysis infrastructure.

V3 materially improved the dataset and evaluation framework, but still failed to establish a repeatable predictive advantage.

Your task is to critically diagnose V3, design a substantially more disciplined forecasting experiment, execute everything possible with the existing environment, and establish a prospective validation process.

**Do not begin by adding more indicators, models, or hyperparameter combinations.**

Your priority is to distinguish real predictive information from historical overfitting.

## 1. Audit the V3 findings

Read all ten V3 reports, source scripts, experiment registries, per-origin predictions, model-selection policies, and validation artifacts.

Investigate these specific findings:

- Weekly LightGBM: 66.30% accuracy, Brier 0.226049.
- Weekly selected policy: Brier 0.256118, worse than neutral.
- Weekly LightGBM improvement interval crosses zero widely.
- Monthly model selection: 60.53% accuracy versus 59.21% always-down.
- Only 19 disjoint weekly and four disjoint monthly evaluation windows.
- Zero individually significant features after multiple-testing correction.
- Monthly prediction intervals were severely undercovered.
- Direction classifiers and distribution models produced conflicting probabilities.

Reproduce these numbers and identify which failures are caused by model architecture, selection procedures, target definitions, data availability, sample limitations, or calibration.

Preserve all existing artifacts and forecasts.

## 2. Freeze a small set of candidate models

Do not run another unrestricted model competition.

For weekly direction, register these candidates:

1. The exact V3 LightGBM configuration.
2. The exact V3 price-plus-sector Ridge configuration.
3. The V3 fixed reversion baseline.
4. Neutral and historical-frequency probability baselines.

For monthly forecasts, prioritize simple historical and regularized distribution models over complicated nonlinear architectures.

Retain exact feature definitions, training rules, and hyperparameters for frozen comparisons.

Do not tune the frozen configurations on the V3 evaluation results.

Any modified model must be registered as a distinct exploratory candidate.

The previously inspected 2025–2026 dates are research-exposed. Replaying these models on those dates is reproduction or stress testing, not independent confirmation.

## 3. Develop coherent probabilistic forecasting

The previous system selected separate models for direction, expected return, median return, quantiles, volatility, and downside risk.

This generated contradictory forecasts.

Research an alternative where the primary output is a single conditional distribution of future NIFTY returns.

From that one distribution, derive:

- Probability of positive return.
- Probability of negative or zero return.
- Expected return.

import numpy as np

def intervals(matrix,h):
    n,k=matrix.shape
    if n<8*h:return [None]*k
    rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);block=2*h;starts=rng.integers(0,n-block+1,(2000,int(np.ceil(n/block))))
    idx=(starts[:,:,None]+np.arange(block)).reshape(2000,-1)[:,:n]
    center=matrix.mean(axis=0);boot=matrix[idx].mean(axis=1);sd=boot.std(axis=0);sd[sd<1e-12]=1e-12
    critical=np.quantile(np.max(abs((boot-center)/sd),axis=1),.95)
    return [[float(m-critical*s),float(m+critical*s)] for m,s in zip(center,sd)]

def run():
    from .ledger import events
    if any(e['kind']=='PROTOCOL_FREEZE' for e in events(OUT/'prospective-ledger.jsonl')):raise ValueError('PROTOCOL_ALREADY_FROZEN: no retrospective threshold changes')

        if h==5:
            outer=v3[(v3.horizon==5)&(v3.split=='outer_exposed')];base=outer.pivot(index='origin',columns='model',values='brier').sort_index()
            for a,b in [('M05_lgbm','Z_reversion'),('M05_lgbm','A00_sector'),('A00_sector','Z_reversion')]:
                deltas.append((base[b]-base[a]).to_numpy());descriptors.append({'horizon':5,'type':'frozen_binary','model':a,'metric':'brier','baseline':b})
            for name,f in stress.groupby('model'):

Four fixed alternatives, no search expansion or outer-driven model selection:

|ID|definition|
|---|---|
|D00_empirical|Latest252 matured return atoms, uniform weights; baseline|
|D01_regime_shrunk|Latest252; causal ret21 sign x training-median RV21; conditional counts plus30 unconditional pseudoobservations|
|D02_student_shrunk|Fixed df5 Student quantile atoms501; location .5*sectorRidge+.5*historicalmean; RMS inner residual scale, floor .005*sqrt(h/5)|
|D03_residual_shrunk|Same shrunk location plus inner heldout sectorRidge residual atoms; no posthoc rescaling|

D00 is the full latest 252 weighted return law, not V3's201-quantile numerical
approximation. D01 uses the same observations and 30 unconditional pseudoobservations.
D02 uses501 fixed Student-t(df5) quantile atoms, scaled by inner residual RMS times
sqrt(3/5), floor .005*sqrt(h/5) before that t variance conversion. D02/D03 location
is .5*sector-Ridge mean+.5*training historical mean; D03 adds the 42 raw heldout
inner residuals. Those residuals are not 42 independent outcomes. Atoms at or below
-100% are floored to-.999999; outputs describe the actual finite law after flooring.
These are new exploratory definitions, not the exact V3 standalone classifier.

For sorted return atoms r_i and normalized weights w_i, all endpoint statistics
come from F: P(up)=sum(w_i for r_i>0), E[R]=sum(w_i*r_i), median/quantiles from the
weighted inverse CDF, buckets from the same weights, E[endpoint]=reference*(1+E[R]),
and expected absolute move=sum(w_i*abs(r_i)). Quantiles cannot cross. Zero empirical
bucket probability means no mass in the fitted finite support, not impossible
real-world outcomes. Log losses alone use1e-6 numerical clipping; displayed laws
are not altered to conceal an extreme probability.

Weighted CRPS=E|R-y|-.5*E|R-R'| is verified against its brute-force definition.
Probability, bucket, endpoint, quantile and magnitude identities are tested.
Future path breaches and future realized volatility are UNAVAILABLE from these
endpoint laws. Endpoint dispersion is labeled endpoint-return standard deviation.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import norm
from .common import *

def intervals(matrix,h):
    n,k=matrix.shape
    if n<8*h:return [None]*k
    rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);block=2*h;starts=rng.integers(0,n-block+1,(2000,int(np.ceil(n/block))))
    idx=(starts[:,:,None]+np.arange(block)).reshape(2000,-1)[:,:n]
    center=matrix.mean(axis=0);boot=matrix[idx].mean(axis=1);sd=boot.std(axis=0);sd[sd<1e-12]=1e-12
    critical=np.quantile(np.max(abs((boot-center)/sd),axis=1),.95)
    return [[float(m-critical*s),float(m+critical*s)] for m,s in zip(center,sd)]

def run():
    dist=pd.read_csv(OUT/'distribution-predictions.csv');stress=pd.read_csv(OUT/'weekly-stress-predictions.csv');cal=pd.read_csv(OUT/'calibration-predictions.csv');_,_,v3=load()
    comparisons=[];power=[]
    for h in [5,21]:
        descriptors=[];deltas=[]
        g=dist[(dist.horizon==h)&(dist.split=='outer_exposed')]
        for metric in ['crps','brier','pinball','mae','bucket_brier']:
            pivot=g.pivot(index='origin',columns='model',values=metric).sort_index()
            for name in ['D01_regime_shrunk','D02_student_shrunk','D03_residual_shrunk']:
                delta=(pivot.D00_empirical-pivot[name]).to_numpy();deltas.append(delta);descriptors.append({'horizon':h,'type':'distribution','model':name,'metric':metric,'baseline':'D00_empirical'})
        if h==5:
            outer=v3[(v3.horizon==5)&(v3.split=='outer_exposed')];base=outer.pivot(index='origin',columns='model',values='brier').sort_index()
            for a,b in [('M05_lgbm','Z_reversion'),('M05_lgbm','A00_sector'),('A00_sector','Z_reversion')]:
                deltas.append((base[b]-base[a]).to_numpy());descriptors.append({'horizon':5,'type':'frozen_binary','model':a,'metric':'brier','baseline':b})
            for name,f in stress.groupby('model'):
                f=f.set_index('origin').reindex(base.index);delta=base.M05_lgbm-(f.p-f.outcome)**2;deltas.append(delta.to_numpy());descriptors.append({'horizon':5,'type':'stress','model':name,'metric':'brier','baseline':'M05_lgbm'})
            for (name,method),f in cal[cal.method!='RAW'].groupby(['model','method']):
                f=f.set_index('origin').reindex(base.index);delta=base[name]-(f.p-f.outcome)**2;deltas.append(delta.to_numpy());descriptors.append({'horizon':5,'type':'calibration','model':name+'|'+method,'metric':'brier','baseline':name})
        matrix=np.column_stack(deltas);sim=intervals(matrix,h)
        for row,delta,ci in zip(descriptors,deltas,sim):comparisons.append({**row,'n':len(delta),'mean_improvement':float(delta.mean()),'paired95':paired_ci(delta,h),'familywise95':ci,'family_contrasts':len(descriptors),'status':'EXPLORATORY_RESEARCH_EXPOSED'})
    # Planning uses disjoint paired losses. This is noisy pilot variance, not a power guarantee.
    for h,metric,model,base,effects in [(5,'brier','M05_lgbm','Z_reversion',[.01,.02,.02319]),(21,'crps','D03_residual_shrunk','D00_empirical',[.001,.002,.005])]:
        data=(v3[(v3.horizon==h)&(v3.split=='outer_exposed')] if h==5 else dist[(dist.horizon==h)&(dist.split=='outer_exposed')])
        pivot=data.pivot(index='origin',columns='model',values=metric).sort_index();ends=data[data.model==model].set_index('origin').endpoint
        pilot=pd.DataFrame({'origin':pivot.index,'endpoint':ends.reindex(pivot.index).to_numpy(),'loss_delta':(pivot[base]-pivot[model]).to_numpy()});pilot=nonoverlap(pilot)
        sd=float(pilot.loss_delta.std(ddof=1));z=float(norm.ppf(1-.05/(2*4))+norm.ppf(.8))
        for effect in effects:
            for inflation in [1.,1.5]:power.append({'horizon':h,'metric':metric,'pilot_disjoint_n':len(pilot),'pilot_paired_sd':sd,'effect_target':effect,'sd_inflation':inflation,
                'required_disjoint_n':int(np.ceil((z*sd*inflation/effect)**2)),'power':.8,'family_alpha':.05,'primary_contrasts':4,
                'assumptions':'Normal approximation, stationary paired loss variance, disjoint outcomes approximately independent; tiny exposed pilot makes estimates uncertain'})
    save('v4-uncertainty.json',comparisons);save('power-assessment.json',power)
    final={str(h):next(r['required_disjoint_n'] for r in power if r['horizon']==h and r['effect_target']==(.01 if h==5 else .001) and r['sd_inflation']==1.5) for h in [5,21]}
    save('prospective-stop-rules.json',{'frozen_at':now(),'fixed_final_disjoint_n':final,'primary_family_size':4,'alpha':.05,

                    if n<100 or np.std(a)<1e-10:continue

`common.py` creates the preservation audit. `data.py`, `extras.py` and
`database_audit.py` implement source discovery and read-only acquisition.
`features.py` records causal source/decision joins. `experiment.py` registers and
runs the initial two-stage model batch. `expansion.py`, `liquidity.py` and
`attribution.py` are separately registered follow-ups. `repair.py` records the
single failed implementation's correction. `discovery.py`, `conditions.py`,
`negative_controls.py` and `analyze.py` retain all inspected effects, proper scores
and uncertainty. `freeze.py` refuses to overwrite an existing issue.

## Resolve frozen experimental forecasts later

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m research.nifty_forecast_v5.score
```

Before a complete horizon matures it makes no network request or ledger mutation.
After endpoint 18:00 IST, it verifies actual observed target sessions, uses the
original frozen reference close, scores all same-horizon laws and their frozen
historical baseline on matched dates, and appends to V5's own hash-chain ledger.
Duplicate resolution is refused/skipped. It never writes V4's ledger. A missing
broker endpoint remains pending; a calendar mismatch requires review. There is
no automatic watcher or schedule, trade API call or live deployment.

The scope remains 2025–2026. The manual scorer refuses a run outside that date
boundary. Adequate monthly validation is not available from four historical
disjoint windows or one newly issued month. Future scope changes require user
instruction.

## Provenance limits

Historical vendor daily anchors are not proven publication clocks; revised source
vintages and unknown futures/CFD close conventions remain limitations. Named
exchange spot close assumptions use IANA timezones/DST plus a two-hour allowance;
unknown conventions use a conservative full extra UTC day. FRED/Treasury access
failures are documented, never filled with invented observations. Current-stock
membership remains a research-only survivorship approximation.

Exact initial fit source and exact issued source are archived separately.
Postfit schema/availability/maturity guards do not change numerical results;
verification independently refits the native lead. Report/reproduction hardening
is separately traceable in the delivery manifest. Keep frozen inputs, predictions
and ledger heads unchanged. Hashes and server Date headers are not external
timestamp notarization.

Most endpoint laws mix65% conditional heldout-residual or leaf/analogue mass
with 35% unconditional historical mass. This reduces unsupported finite-support
certainty but is a fixed heuristic, not certified calibration. All parameters
were fixed within each registered batch; no automatic hyperparameter search.

Multi-horizon M00 shares1/3/5/21 targets normalized bysqrt(h) with a log-horizon
coordinate, date-balanced tasks and individually matured labels. It fails to
improve primary horizons. Structured cross-market lags were actually tested.
Small temporal CNN/RNN/attention/Transformer models were not run:403 daily origins
and four disjoint monthly windows cannot validate an additional neural search.
Millions of intraday snapshots do not change that. XGBoost/CatBoost duplicate
sweeps were not added; new additive/kernel/conditional-forest mechanisms already
test nonlinear alternatives. Formal HMM/Markov and latent dynamic-factor models
were not claimed: causal observed regimes and rolling factors are narrower tests.

V5 did not stop after failed global/transfer/factor results. It followed the
domestic lead with registered source ablations and then genuinely new ETF/liquidity
inputs. Every inspected expansion adds to the multiple-comparison family. Failed
results remain in experiment-registry.csv/json, with exact model artifact hashes.
No V4 candidate, source code, protocol or prospective ledger was modified.

Full numerical reproduction completed in a new isolated directory without market
data requests: all 34 systems and 11,992 historical records matched. Probability
and Brier differences were exactly0; maximum CRPS difference was below7e-18.
This verifies repeatability, not independent validation. Original failed attempts
remain preserved; corrected code need not repeat the metadata bug in the replay.
Nonlinear comparisons also differ in representations, so a losing kernel/additive
implementation does not identify an architecture's universal causal weakness.

# V5 cross-market features and time alignment

The initial matrix has 176 features:13 price/risk,52 native internals,52 aligned
global returns,19 derivative/transformed,18 structured lags,12 fixed cross-market
relationships and 10 research-only stock-breadth features. Separate liquidity
files add15 ETF and three research-only wider-stock volume features.

Global relationships include equal-weight available-market return/dispersion,
Indian-minus-global relative returns, oil x USD/INR, global return x participation,
US Tech100 versus Indian IT performance, Asia-minus-Europe divergence, equity/oil
divergence,21-session Indian/global and inter-global correlations, correlation
changes and cross-asset movement variability. No huge interaction-grid optimizer
was used. These features can be correlated and are not independent signals.

Premarket historical clock09:10 IST follows the completed Indian reference.
Known spot markets use IANA NewYork/London/Berlin/Paris/HongKong/Tokyo exchange
closing clocks plus a conservative two-hour publication allowance, handling DST.
Foreign daily bar dates remain source-session assumptions; receipt/revision
history is not authenticated. Unknown futures/CFD/FX conventions use a full extra
UTC-day completion buffer (source midnight+2days), not a fabricated exact close.
Actual available bars/holidays are respected by as-of joins; gaps over seven days
are missing, not indefinitely forward-filled. All assumed completion timestamps
are <=the recorded historical decision. No actual as-delivered vintage is claimed.

The extra global-delay stress C01_delayglobal adds an Indian-session lag to the
global/relationship block and stays exploratory. European/US close assumptions
and daily-anchor semantics remain a risk even with timezone-aware code; causal
code alone does not authenticate vendor publication history.

realized variation and volume/prior21median. Gold/silver exposure is INR ETF
exposure, not spot; foreign ETFs carry tracking/premium/currency effects. The
price-only, native-only and joint liquidity ablations isolate the whole new block,
not each ETF's causal effect. Wider-stock median activity/active advances/volume
dispersion remain research-only current-basket proxies.

# V5 research conclusions

**V5 discovered stronger retrospective hypotheses, not an independently validated
forecasting edge. Continue research; NO DEPLOYMENT.**

What is new: expanded 193-instrument universe, native broad/size/style internals,
13-global timezone-aware lead/lag and relative-state study, nine-sector and 150-stock
date-grouped transfer, static/rolling factors, additive/kernel/conditional-forest
models, cross-market analogues/sequences, multi-horizon auxiliary learning, ETF/
volume expansion, conditional exact-regime baselines and feature-versus-law attribution.
All 34 systems and expansions were registered before their own evaluation, with
no automatic hyperparameter mining. The later expansions were motivated by exposed
results and explicitly do not become predeclared independent confirmation.

What improved historically: I00 weekly Brier.186099 and 76.09% accuracy; no-size
stress.182047; ETF/native L01 CRPS.009963 with 77.17% 80%-interval coverage. The
native lead survives September exclusion descriptively. Fifteen weekly adjusted
comparison lower bounds are positive against weaker empirical/neutral/price
benchmarks under the 458-contrast family. None establishes adjusted superiority
over the strongest prior V4 coherent model; no adjusted distribution-score gain
qualifies a robust retrospective candidate. All historical dates remain exposed.

What did not improve: global increment beyond native internals; derivatives
increment beyond joint state; pooled sector/stock transfer; PCA loading adaptation;
most nonlinear/kernel/additive and auxiliary models; monthly calibration. Newly
added broad indices have small/uncertain incremental value over legacy sectors.
ETF CRPS gains coexist with worse Brier relative to I00. Current-stock proxies
cannot establish historically accurate NIFTY breadth. No individually significant
global lead/lag feature survives976-test BH correction.

Important attribution: even exact old sector estimators improve with the new
distribution construction (weekly AT00 Brier.199665), and new features under the
old law produce.198850. The joint new system .186099 cannot be described as proof
that global, derivatives or a larger feature count caused the improvement.

What remains missing: authenticated historical source receipt/revision clocks,
dated stock membership/weights/corporate-action vintages, accessible US bond/USD/
risk panels, enough independent monthly outcomes, and frozen genuinely new resolved
forecasts. This run did not abandon discovery merely because confirmation is absent.

"""Development-only cross-market lead/lag and noncausal information diagnostics."""
from scipy.stats import rankdata
from .common import *
from .data import load

def bh(p):
    p=np.asarray(p);o=np.argsort(p);ranked=p[o]*len(p)/np.arange(1,len(p)+1);q=np.minimum.accumulate(ranked[::-1])[::-1];out=np.empty(len(p));out[o]=np.minimum(q,1);return out
def run():
    x=pd.read_csv(OUT/'features.csv',index_col=0);data,_=load();records=[]
    names=[c for c in x if c.startswith(('g_','x_','b_'))]
    save('lead-lag-plan.json',{'registered_at':now(),'features':names,'lags':[0,1,3,5],'targets':['NIFTY5','NIFTY21','IT5','IT21'],'development_endpoint_cutoff':'2026-07-01','null':'200 circular shifts with separation>=2H; BH across all tests; no causation claim','no_test_selection':True})
    for h in [5,21]:
        labs=pd.read_csv(OUT/f'labels-{h}.csv',index_col=0);ix=labs.index[labs.endpoint.notna()&(labs.endpoint<'2026-07-01')]
        for target in ['NIFTY','IT']:
            y=labs['return'] if target=='NIFTY' else data['nifty_it'].close.reindex(x.index).shift(-h)/data['nifty_it'].close.reindex(x.index)-1
            for name in names:
                for lag in [0,1,3,5]:
                    xx=x[name].shift(lag).reindex(ix);yy=y.reindex(ix);m=xx.notna()&yy.notna();a=xx[m].to_numpy();b=yy[m].to_numpy();n=len(a)
                    if n<100 or np.std(a)<1e-10:continue
                    ar=rankdata(a);br=rankdata(b);ar=(ar-ar.mean())/ar.std();br=(br-br.mean())/br.std();ic=float(ar@br/n)
                    rng=np.random.default_rng(SEED);shifts=rng.integers(2*h,n-2*h,200);null=np.array([ar@np.roll(br,int(s))/n for s in shifts]);p=float((1+np.sum(abs(null)>=abs(ic)))/201)
                    half=n//2
                    corr=lambda u,v:float(np.corrcoef(rankdata(u),rankdata(v))[0,1])
                    records.append({'horizon':h,'target':target,'feature':name,'lag':lag,'n':n,'rank_ic':ic,'first_half_ic':corr(a[:half],b[:half]),'second_half_ic':corr(a[half:],b[half:]),'p_shift':p,'causation':False})
    frame=pd.DataFrame(records);frame['bh_q']=bh(frame.p_shift);frame.to_csv(OUT/'global-lead-lag-discovery.csv',index=False)
    # Rolling correlations and factor relationships already causal features; no significance from visual similarity.
    save('discovery-summary.json',{'tests':len(frame),'min_bh_q':float(frame.bh_q.min()),'q_under_05':int((frame.bh_q<.05).sum()),'top':frame.sort_values('bh_q').head(20).to_dict('records')})
    print('Global-to-NIFTY/IT lead-lag tests',len(frame),'minq',frame.bh_q.min(),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':run()
